Indeks kecenderungan sel menjadi jenuh a: Index of a cell's tendency to become saturated: the higher the value, the more water collects and the gentler the slope.
Indeks komposit (kerawanan banjir, poten: Composite indices (flood susceptibility, recharge potential, erosion susceptibility) are scaled 0-1 relative to the study area and are topographic and indicative only. They are not a hydraulic model or a soil-loss estimate.
Indeks relatif berbasis topografi. Bobot: Relative topography-based index. Default weights are equal (neutral); adjust according to local studies/AHP and validate against flood history.
Indikator relatif, bukan daya aliran seb: A relative indicator, not the actual stream power.

Jaringan hasil DEM mengikuti ambang yang: The DEM-derived network follows the chosen threshold and is not the real river network; validate with imagery or an official hydrography map.

Prevents division by zero on flat areas.

Mengekstraksi jaringan sungai dari amban: Extracts the stream network from a catchment-area threshold, then assigns Strahler order, Shreve magnitude, length and slope to each segment (link).

Morfometri hanya memuat data dasar karen: Morphometry contains only basic data because there are no streams at the chosen threshold.

Sel dengan luas tangkapan hulu >= ambang: Cells whose upstream catchment area is >= the threshold are treated as stream. Adjust it to the river map/imagery. Used by all stream network, watershed and HAND analyses and their derivatives.
Selisih elevasi sel terhadap rata-rata e: Difference between a cell's elevation and the mean elevation of its neighbourhood: positive = ridge, negative = valley.
Seluruh analisis dihitung dari DEM saja;: All analyses are computed from the DEM alone; no rainfall, soil, land-cover or measured discharge data were used.
Seluruh analisis hidrologi yang dapat di: Every hydrology analysis that can be derived from a DEM, with automatic symbology, standard maps, an Excel summary and a PDF report.
Sensitif terhadap derau DEM; pertimbangk: Sensitive to DEM noise; consider smoothing the DEM if the result is too noisy.
Setiap baris = satu unit. Rumus dan dasa: Each row = one unit. Formulas and basis are listed in the notes below the table.
Setiap sel dilabeli ruas sungai tempat a: Each cell is labelled with the stream segment it drains to, then segments of order < N are merged into their downstream segment.
Skala kecil/besar harus sesuai ukuran be: The small/large scales must match the size of the landforms in the area.
Skor = jumlah(w_i x n_i) / jumlah(w_i);: Score = sum(w_i x n_i) / sum(w_i); n_i is the factor normalised to 0-1 (2nd-98th percentile).
Skor kerawanan banjir dari gabungan HAND: Flood susceptibility score combining HAND, slope, TWI, catchment area and distance to stream.
Skor kerawanan erosi dari sisi topografi: Topographic erosion susceptibility score: LS factor, SPI and slope.
Skor potensi resapan dari sisi topografi: Topographic recharge potential score: gentle slopes, water-collecting areas, sparse drainage, smooth surface.
Statistik keluaran raster (di dalam bata: Raster output statistics (inside the study boundary)
Sudut = arah lereng terbesar pada 8 segi: Angle = direction of steepest slope on the 8 triangular facets; flow is split between two receivers according to the angle. SCA = A / cell width (m2/m).

Tidak ada sel sungai pada ambang %.1f ha: No stream cells at the %.1f ha threshold; lower the catchment-area threshold.
Tidak memodelkan dinamika air; DEM harus: Does not model water dynamics; the DEM must include the sea/estuary at its edge.
Tidak memuat tanah, geologi, atau tutupa: Does not include soil, geology or land cover: complement it with those layers before using it to designate recharge zones.
Tinggi tiap sel di atas sel sungai tempa: Height of each cell above the stream cell its flow path drains to; flow distance and straight-line distance to the stream.
Titik '%s' berada di luar DEM dan dilewa: Point '%s' is outside the DEM and was skipped.
Titik '%s' berada di sel dengan luas tan: Point '%s' lies on a cell with a catchment area of %.1f ha (below the stream threshold).
Titik '%s' digeser %.0f m ke sungai; per: Point '%s' was moved %.0f m to the stream; check its position.
Titik dipindah ke sel beraliran tertingg: Points are moved to the highest-flow cell within this radius; points moved too far are reported.
Titik keluar adalah tepi DEM/area valid,: Outlets are the DEM edge/valid-area edge, not always the true river mouth.
Titik outlet / pour point (opsional, unt: Outlet / pour point (optional, for point-based watersheds)
Ukuran kekasaran permukaan: akar jumlah: Surface roughness measure: square root of the sum of squared elevation differences between a cell and its 8 neighbours.
Waktu tempuh air dari tiap sel ke titik: Travel time of water from each cell to the outlet (isochrone map) and the time-area function.
Waktu tempuh ke titik keluar; untuk DAS: Travel time to the outlet; for point-based watersheds the time is computed to that watershed's outlet.
Zona genangan berdasarkan beberapa skena: Inundation zones for several water-level scenarios above the stream bed, derived from HAND. Each cell receives the lowest water level that floods it; area, mean depth and volume per scenario go into the table.
DAS '%s' menyentuh tepi DEM; perbesar bu: Watershed '%s' touches the DEM edge; increase the DEM buffer so the watershed is complete.
DAS = seluruh sel yang jalur alirannya m: Watershed = all cells whose flow path passes through the outlet cell.
DAS dari titik outlet yang ditentukan pe: Watersheds from user-defined outlet points (point layer). Points are snapped to the highest-accumulation cell nearby; nested watersheds are computed in full.
DAS titik outlet tidak ikut morfometri:: Outlet-point watersheds were left out of the morphometry: %s
DEM ber-CRS geografis akan diproyeksikan: A DEM in a geographic CRS is reprojected to UTM automatically. Elevation values must be in metres.
DEM dipotong lebih luas dari batas studi: The DEM is clipped wider than the study boundary so upstream catchment area outside the boundary is counted. Results are still clipped to the study boundary.
DSM (misalnya hasil fotogrametri atau Li: A DSM (e.g. from photogrammetry or surface LiDAR) contains canopy and buildings that can divert flow; use a DTM when available.
